messages:
casey: Customer says they redeemed promo at checkout, got the confirmation email, but account balance stayed the same. Promo code: PROMO-TRIAL-50. Customer org is org-acme-77.
promo-bot: Promo redeem accepted 
{
  "claim_id": "cl_54a1",
  "org_id": "org-temp-9",
  "amount_usd_cents": 5000,
  "status": "applied",
  "applied_at": "2026-03-11T14:02:13Z"
}
casey: Hmm — bot shows applied to org-temp-9, not org-acme-77. customer says they never saw org-temp-9.

devon: Looking at signup logs for the customer's email (james@acme.com). There is a duplicate org created 2026-03-11T13:58:42Z during an SSO retry: org-temp-9. SSO flow created a throwaway org because the redirect param was missing. Promo redemption happened right after and landed on that org.

devon: Quick repro: sign up via SSO, interrupt redirect, hit redeem endpoint with session cookie -> redemption binds to session's current org.

devon: Ledger entry id: le_984321 shows amount 50.00 USD and org_id org-temp-9, posted=TRUE.
casey: So credits are posted, but to the wrong org. Customer can't see them.
mikhail: Ok. Root cause: redemption bound to ephemeral org created by interrupted SSO. Policy: we should block redeem unless org has an owner with verified email, but that's a product decision. For support fix we can either move ledger entry or issue a manual credit to org-acme-77 and void the one on org-temp-9.

devon: Minimal fix steps I recommend:
1) Create a reversing ledger entry for le_984321 with amount -5000 referencing reason \"promo misapplied\".
2) Create a new ledger entry crediting org-acme-77 amount 5000 with same claim_id in metadata.
3) Run billing.reconcile_claims(claim_id=cl_54a1) to mark the promo as satisfied.

Example SQL (internal only):
```sql
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (id, org_id, amount_cents, reason, metadata, created_by)
VALUES ('le_984322', 'org-temp-9', -5000, 'promo misapplied - reversal', '{"claim_id":"cl_54a1"}', 'support/manual');
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (id, org_id, amount_cents, reason, metadata, created_by)
VALUES ('le_984323', 'org-acme-77', 5000, 'promo reapply', '{"claim_id":"cl_54a1"}', 'support/manual');
COMMIT;
```

devon: Then trigger job: `POST /internal/jobs/reconcile?claim_id=cl_54a1` or run `billing.reconcile_pending_credits()` from admin console. That will update balances and emit audit logs.
mikhail: Sounds good. I'll run the reversal + reapply. Using internal tool: https://internal.redwood/billing/adjust (requires SSO). Reason: customer promo applied to ephemeral org during SSO redirect failure.
casey: @mikhail please escalate priority — customer is on trial and expecting credits before end of day.
mikhail: Acknowledged. Running now. I'll paste receipts.
mikhail: Reversal entry created le_984322, reapply entry le_984323. Kicked reconcile job job_20260311_01.

devon: I see the audit events: claim_id cl_54a1 now linked to org-acme-77. Balance for org-acme-77 increased by $50.00. org-temp-9 balance decreased accordingly.
casey: Notified customer: "We found the credits were applied to an ephemeral org created during SSO — we've moved them to your main org. You should see the $50 trial credit in billing > balance within ~10 minutes. Sorry for the confusion."
mikhail: Follow-up: we should rate-limit promo redemption for sessions without a verified owner, and add a check to the redeem webhook to prefer org from verified account or redirect param. Filing a short follow-up ticket for product.
devon: Filed P0 bug: GH#edge/5692 - promo redemption attaches to session-only orgs.
casey: Thanks all. Closing once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
mikhail: Customer replied: "I see it now, thanks!" Closing.
